artworks.title: St James's Street
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image is a street view from an elevated perspective. A busy city street is depicted, with tall buildings on either side. In the distance, a clock tower or similar building is faintly visible. The architecture is detailed and rendered in fine, linear brushstrokes. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, giving it a classic aesthetic. Figures and horse-drawn carts populate the street, creating a lively atmosphere. The street narrows in the distance, leading the viewer's eye towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Swan and Iris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial perspective of a waterbody with a distant horizon, featuring trees and rooftops. The artwork employs etching with fine lines to depict water and plant life. The color scheme includes sepia tones, giving the piece an antique look. In the foreground, there is a detailed etching of a plant with a flower.

artworks.title: A Sketch of the Embankment
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a riverside cityscape with figures in the foreground. The image depicts a group of indistinct and lightly constructed figures positioned along what appears to be a waterfront or promenade. The cityscape in the background consists of sketched outlines indicating buildings with spires, rooftops, and various architectural elements, providing a distant urban backdrop. The drawing utilizes delicate lines and minimal detail. The figures in the foreground are also minimally detailed, suggesting motion and life with their fluid outlines against the structured horizon, creating a contrast between the human forms and the urban skyline.

artworks.title: The Fish Shop, Busy Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.7 x 21.7 cm (5 3/8 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with a row of shops. The intricate pen and ink drawing shows detailed facades, windows, and awnings of the buildings lining the street. The architecture features double-hung windows and awnings with shop front displays underneath. Cross-hatching and linework are used to create textures for materials and shadows. The scene appears lively with figures and movement in front of the shops, typical of urban environments. The line quality adds charm to this street setting, capturing a busy day.

artworks.title: Bucking Horse
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image displays an elevated perspective of people engaged in outdoor activities. The scene features sparse and thin brushstrokes with a monochromatic color palette, primarily in sepia or light beige tones. The composition includes outlined figures engaging in various activities, with a horizon line near the top of the image. In the foreground, two figures in hats sit near a fence, while other figures and riders on horseback are dispersed across the scene.

artworks.title: The Steps, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.7 x 16.4 cm (9 5/16 x 6 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a waterfront building with a stairway leading up to a porch. The image depicts a scene by the water, with details of the building facade featuring windows adorned with curtains, a set of steps leading up to a porch, and various objects or possibly figures detailed along the entrance. The drawing uses fine lines to create depth and texture, conveying architectural detailing and reflections in the water in the foreground. The composition includes symmetry and balance typical of etchings emphasizing line work and shading.

artworks.title: Acrobat on a Horse (Voltigeuse zu Pferd)
artworks.medium: drypoint on blotting paper
artworks.description: The image displays dynamic and erratic lines forming an intricate pattern suggesting movement. The shapes appear to merge a horse and a human figure, intertwining to create fluidity. The human form leans over the horse with outstretched limbs. In the background, linear shapes hint at spectators or an audience. The composition blends familiar elements into a stylized scene challenging traditional representations.

artworks.title: Female Nude
artworks.medium: woodcut on blotting paper
artworks.description: This print shows an abstract depiction of a nude person seated with their body turned away from us. We can see their back and part of their profile. The person's head is turned toward the left, with their chin tucked towards their shoulder, and no distinct facial features are visible. Their hair is short and dark, styled close to their head. The person is seated in a circular basin or tub, with lines and patterns around them. The background is patterned with linear and dot-like shapes. The white lines of the print are very thick on the black background.

artworks.title: A Young Girl Looking Upward
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts the upper body of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is slightly turned to the side, with their head tilted upwards and turned towards the left side of the image. The facial features include large, expressive eyes and slightly parted lips. The hair is curled and partially covered by a headscarf. The clothing appears draped loosely around the shoulders, with the fabric falling lightly. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a light, unadorned surface with shading for contrast.

artworks.title: Christ Leading Peter, James, and John to the High Mountain for the Transfiguration
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink and pen and black ink over black chalk with a variety of gray, black, brown and golden brown washes

artworks.title: A Shepherd Family Resting
artworks.medium: red chalk and wash over graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring animals and a human figure in a rural setting. The scene includes a person resting against a large rock, a dog standing nearby, a cow, and a child. In the background, there are sketched foliage and distant rural village structures. The drawing is done in soft reddish tones.

artworks.title: A Bridge in Auvergne (Un pont en Auvergne)
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine applique
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge over a river, with water cascading over rocks in the foreground. Lush trees line both sides of the bridge, extending into the background. The etching technique creates detailed foliage and river movement. The monochromatic color palette of black and white highlights light and shadow, resulting in a dramatic yet tranquil scene.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a standing figure and two reclining figures. The artwork is in the style of an early Renaissance or German Renaissance print. The scene depicts a central figure standing under a tree with arms raised. Around this figure, there are intricate details of foliage and landscape, drawn in a highly detailed and textured manner characteristic of woodcut prints. In the foreground, two other figures recline on the ground, showing a contrast in posture to the standing figure. The expressions and drapery of their clothing are finely etched, showcasing the artist's attention to detail. The overall composition conveys a narrative moment.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed architectural scene featuring a group of people in period clothing. The composition displays numerous figures adorned in ornate historical attire around a grand architectural setting with soaring arches and decorative columns. The figures appear engaged in a scene within a structured, interior space. The drawing emphasizes intricate line work and shading to convey depth and texture within the stonework and clothing.

artworks.title: Monsieur and Madame Blizet with Monsieur Le Roy the Actor
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over red and black chalks with touches of graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Carter Stevenson in memory of Sir Geoffrey Agnew
artworks.description: The image contains three individuals. The first person, a man, is playing a violin on the left side. The second person, a woman, is seated in the center wearing a decorated gown and holding a fan. The third person, another man, is seated on the right. The setting appears to be a classical or baroque-style room with a large column to the right and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Poppy in Bloom
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of large, leafy plants with intricately drawn foliage. The color scheme is sepia tones on a cream background. The largest cluster of leaves is at the lower half, with a smaller cluster on the right side.

artworks.title: Poppy in Bloom
artworks.medium: red chalk counterproof on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows intricate leaf patterns in a reddish-brown tone on a light background. The design features large foliage with tendrils and stems extending outward, creating a sense of organic movement.

artworks.title: Poppies with Seed Pods
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of several poppy plants with flowers and seed heads. The color palette is primarily soft sepia tones, creating a monochromatic appearance. The poppy plants are depicted vertically in the center of the image, with leaves spreading outward and flowers and seed heads reaching in different directions. They occupy most of the composition against a light background.

artworks.title: Flowering Plant with Grass
artworks.medium: red chalk with wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of tall plants with elongated leaves and clusters of small flowers at the top, all rendered in a single brownish-red color. The monochrome palette primarily consists of varying shades of brownish-red, giving the drawing a vintage, sepia-toned look. The plants are centrally positioned, filling most of the frame, with their leaves and stems stretching outward. The flowers and leaves create a textured and layered appearance against a light, blank background.

artworks.title: Flowering Plant with Buds
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a leafy plant with large, textured leaves in a sepia tone. The plant is centered in the composition, with faint outlines of additional foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Pont Aberglaslyn
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a waterfall flowing under a stone bridge. On the bridge, there are two figures on horseback and one standing. The brushstrokes are soft, resembling watercolor. In the background, there are tall mountains fading into misty clouds. The color scheme consists of earth tones, blues, and grays.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Standing Lady
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch displaying a person standing in an upright position. The person has curly hair, defined facial features, and is wearing an elaborate dress. The background features an outdoor setting with classical architectural elements and foliage.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Standing Lady
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a person standing in an elegant pose. The figure leans against a round table with both hands placed on it. The face has minimal detail, with slight emphasis on the eyes and mouth. The hair is styled in an updo. The person wears a flowing gown with intricate details on the sleeves and bodice, with buttons and a defined waistline. A cloak drapes from the shoulders to the floor. The table holds an unspecified object. In the background, there are abstract shapes indicating a curtain on the left and foliage, implying an interior setting with a hint of the outdoors.

artworks.title: Aerial View of Theatre
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate theatrical stage or arena. It features an enclosed space with high walls adorned with numerous sculptures and decorative elements, multiple tiers of seating ascending the walls on both sides, and a large horse-drawn chariot in the center. Figures and additional horses are dispersed throughout the scene. The architecture includes ornately detailed structures topped with crowns and eagles, suggesting a regal or imperial theme. The precision of line work and detailed ornamentation is reminiscent of baroque aesthetics.
